messages.text: Where is my order? Order #Hi Alina.  I just want to make sure the globe mentions Lake Ontario, not whatever the American's have chosen to call it now.  Can you confirm?.

Good news: our globes are labeled Gulf of Mexico and the Great Lakes keep their traditional names, so you'll see Lake Ontario, not anything else — no American renamings make it onto our maps.

On the Replogle Regency 16" Antique Raised Relief Floor Globe you were looking at, that holds true too. It's a beautiful piece — antique raised-relief map, fine furniture-quality stand, a real centerpiece for a study or living room.

Is this one for your own space, or a gift?
